characters.name: Joseph Smith Sr.
characters.blurb: Joseph's father: a hard-working New England farmer and patriarch of the Smith family.

characters.name: Joseph Smith
characters.blurb: The central figure of the Restoration, modeled at child, teenage, and adult ages.

characters.name: Emma Hale Smith
characters.blurb: Joseph's wife, principal scribe during the translation, and a leader in the early Relief Society.

characters.name: Hyrum Smith
characters.blurb: Joseph's older brother, Patriarch to the Church, and his companion at Carthage.

characters.name: Lucy Mack Smith
characters.blurb: Joseph's mother, family matriarch, and author of a foundational family memoir.

characters.name: Brigham Young
characters.blurb: Apostle and later second President of the Church, who led the westward migration.

characters.name: Oliver Cowdery
characters.blurb: Principal scribe during the Book of Mormon translation and one of the Three Witnesses.

characters.name: Martin Harris
characters.blurb: Farmer, financier of the first printing, and one of the Three Witnesses.

characters.name: David Whitmer
characters.blurb: One of the Three Witnesses and a member of the Fayette, New York household.

characters.name: Jacob Whitmer
characters.blurb: One of the Eight Witnesses who examined the plates in Fayette.

characters.name: John Whitmer
characters.blurb: One of the Eight Witnesses and the first official Church historian.

characters.name: Sidney Rigdon
characters.blurb: Campbellite preacher, First Presidency counselor, and a powerful early orator.

characters.name: Moroni
characters.blurb: The angelic messenger who directed Joseph to the plates; a reverent, older robed interpretation.

characters.name: Nephi
characters.blurb: Book of Mormon prophet and first narrator, useful for scripture tableaux.

characters.name: Laman
characters.blurb: Eldest son of Lehi in the Book of Mormon narrative.

characters.name: Lemuel
characters.blurb: Son of Lehi and brother of Nephi in the Book of Mormon narrative.

characters.name: Alma the Younger
characters.blurb: Book of Mormon prophet and missionary, modeled for scripture tableaux.

characters.name: Heavenly Father
characters.blurb: A reverent artistic interpretation of the Father in the First Vision narrative.

characters.name: John the Baptist
characters.blurb: The New Testament forerunner who restored the Aaronic Priesthood in the Restoration narrative.
